svg.aria-label: Bar chart of the table below: how many times faster oneyaml-csharp is than the strongest competitor on each task, log scale, higher is better. 7 tasks: 6 better, 0 level, 0 mixed, 0 worse, 1 not comparable.
svg.title: oneyaml-csharp: speed per task against the strongest competitor
svg.desc: oneyaml-csharp: speed per task against the strongest competitor. Times faster than the strongest competitor on each task (geometric mean over its workloads), log scale: bars to the right are faster, higher is better, bars to the left are slower. Unchanged emit times the write path of a document that was not edited; a library that keeps the text returns it without rendering, so it is not a rendering speed. A † marks a cell measured differently from the task as specified. typed load 1.24× faster win (ours 45.8 µs vs 56.8 µs; workloads: 1 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 1); generic load 1.33× faster win (ours 22.5 µs vs 30 µs; workloads: 7 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 7); dump 2.40× faster win (ours 5.21 µs vs 12.5 µs; workloads: 6 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 6); document parse 11.6× faster win (ours 16.4 µs vs 191 µs; workloads: 7 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 7); unchanged emit (write-back of an unedited document; not a rendering speed) 2.41× faster win (ours 515 ns vs 1.24 µs; workloads: 7 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 7); edit script 67.1× faster win (ours 8.38 µs vs 563 µs; workloads: 6 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 6); patch (RFC 6902) no rival.
